name: Onna Tantei Anna no Oshigoto File 1 ~Dungeon Onsen no Chousa~
original_name: 女探偵アンナのお仕事ファイル1～ダンジョン温泉の調査〜
source:
A story that focuses on a female detective in a fantasy world.
Anna is pure and clumsy, and opens up a detective agency.
She goes through sexual events while searching for her missing mother.
